status: Offline candidate; not deployed or tested with actual speech/Google after this change.
changes: Default hold-to-talk keeps Live and camera connected; microphone track disabled and PCM gated while idle.
Release, cancellation, blur, hidden tab, Stop and disconnect invalidate pending audio sends.
Server receipts remain visible after actual responses; browser OS speech removed from receipt path.
Native conversation and robot tools remain in one mode; whole-turn output buffer unchanged.
512-frame capture reduces nominal partial-buffer exposure to32ms at16kHz; not a timing or speech-recognition guarantee.
limitations: Automatic VAD may respond while held; release is not robot Stop.
Whole-turn audio buffering still adds latency.
Claim screening remains heuristic; no claim of universally truthful native speech.
Real microphone last-syllable recognition and user comfort need a brief live check.
Hold-to-talk is a deliberate input control, not an implemented wake word.
local_rehearsal_servers: Both task-owned fake API and static server stopped cleanly after the completed browser run.
